content_sections.heading: CUG Doctor Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CUG Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CUG Doctor (Medical Officer) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Doctor (Medical Officer): MBBS or equivalent from a recognized institution approved by Medical Council of India with minimum two years experience, or MD, or equivalent

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CUG Doctor (Medical Officer) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for CUG recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the CUG recruitment 2026 is Doctor (Medical Officer).

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Doctor (Medical Officer) in CUG?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Doctor (Medical Officer) post at Central University of Gujarat.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for CUG Doctor (Medical Officer) recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for CUG Doctor (Medical Officer) recruitment is scheduled for 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for CUG Doctor (Medical Officer) recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the CUG Doctor (Medical Officer) recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Doctor (Medical Officer) at CUG?
faq.answer: The salary for the Doctor (Medical Officer) post at Central University of Gujarat is Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for Doctor (Medical Officer) in CUG?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS or equivalent from an MCI-approved institution with two years experience, or an MD or equivalent degree.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CUG Doctor (Medical Officer) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Doctor (Medical Officer) post at CUG is a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this CUG recruitment?
faq.answer: This CUG recruitment for Doctor (Medical Officer) is for a Contractual job type.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for CUG Doctor (Medical Officer) post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Doctor (Medical Officer) post is Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the CUG walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents along with self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificate (if applicable).
